messages.author: e6352c03758df1af
messages.subject: Double haploid population
parts:
Dear Karl,
I have double haploid population(DH) from one F1 (only AA,BB,
plant, not animals), when I read into programe, it recognized as F2
population(strange genotype without H), can R/qtl handle type of data?
Regards
Ping

messages.author: d5fdb09d679f8c32
messages.subject: Re: Double haploid population
parts:
You can treat the data as a backcross. If you are reading the data in
the CSV
format you can specify that by something like this:

cr <-
read.cross(format="csv",dir=".",file="myfile.csv",genotypes=c("AA","BB"))

This will tell R/qtl that the second genotype "BB" is to be treated as
a het, and
since the other homozygote is not present, will think it is a
backcross.

Saunak
